name: swipe-tabs
title: Swipe tabs
description: Tabs for phones: panels swipe sideways on scroll-snap, the underline follows your finger between tabs, and a mouse gets plain tabs with arrow keys.
docs: Give it a height when the panels should scroll on their own (h-full inside a flex column, or a fixed height); without one it is as tall as its tallest panel. Pass tabs (value, label, icon, content), then value and onValueChange to control it, or defaultValue. The panels are one row of scroll-snap, so the browser does the swiping and the momentum: a swipe selects the new tab once the track has settled, a tap on a tab slides to its panel, and the underline and the label colours are drawn from the scroll position on every frame. Only the selected panel is exposed to assistive technology; the others are inert. lazy mounts the selected panel and its neighbours only, and a tap on a far tab starts one panel away so the slide never shows a blank. swipeable={false} leaves the tabs and the arrow keys (Left, Right, Home, End) as the only way to move. Under reduced motion the slide is an instant change. A bar of tabs wider than the screen scrolls with the underline, keeps the selected tab in view and fades at the edge it continues past. It follows right-to-left text. A controlled parent that refuses a change gets the track slid back to the selected tab. Use barClassName for a sticky bar and panelClassName for the padding of the panels.
